en.title: Hmong (H'Mông) culture in Tà Xùa: New Year, homes, etiquette
en.excerpt: Hmong culture in Tà Xùa: Hmong New Year (08/01/2027), bánh dày, indigo brocade, wooden houses, khèn and 8 rules for visiting villages and taking photos.

ko.title: 따쑤아 흐몽족 문화: 흐몽 설, 목조 가옥, 예절
